name: fresh-handoff
description: Create bounded, acknowledgement-gated handoffs for session-safe continuation of long-running Codex work.

interface.longDescription: Write a bounded session-scoped capsule, verify exact transfer identity in a clean Codex task, and acknowledge before single-writer ownership transfers without inheriting the old conversation.
defaultPrompt: Checkpoint this task with a self-contained session revision and report readiness.
Resume from the exact delivered path, SHA-256, source, transfer, goal, revision, and nonce; acknowledge before implementation.
Evaluate handoff quality and token efficiency without claiming improvement before the paired gate passes.
